TERRIBLE experience - HIGHLY UNPROFESSIONAL do not use  -

I recently engaged the services of Town Movers through Airtasker for what should have been a fairly simple move, and my experience was nothing short of a nightmare. I feel compelled to share my ordeal to alert others and express my deep dissatisfaction with this service provider.

From the outset, the removalists were late, they didn't communicate well, they said they were having problems with the truck.  I had to call them three times and threatened to cancel the job if they didn't turn up in 10 mins as they had promised on several occassions.  My daughter and I took time off work for the move and this causing a significant disruption to my moving schedule. Upon their arrival, it was evident that they were not only unprofessional but also incompitent and incapable of operating their own truck efficiently.  They couldn't operate the back lift.

Throughout the commencement of the moving process, their behavior was appalling. They took a matress and openly yelled at each other, creating a tense and threatening environment. This lack of professionalism extended to their loading the matress via via stairs, posing a real risk of damage to my other items.  I cancelled the job requested they return the matress which was the only item loaded and leave.

They refused to return my mattress, they called their "boss" and became confrontational.  As a result I felt compelled to threaten involving the police to resolve the matter, a situation I never expected to encounter during a simple moving process.

To add insult to injury, their "boss" is now demanding full payment for a job that was not completed.   I have lodged a complaint with Airtasker, and I hope they take appropriate action against such unscrupulous service providers.

I strongly advise anyone considering the services of Town Movers to think twice. The lack of professionalism, disregard for customer concerns, and the overall incompetence displayed during my brief encounter was unacceptable. I regret choosing them and hope that my experience serves as a cautionary tale for others.

Please feel free to reach out if you would like further information.

Do not use this company, highly unprofessional, rude and damaged our belongings.

We thought the service and price would’ve been better by using a small local business
We were quoted a 4-hour move with our houses being less than 15 minutes apart; we were extremely organised with everything in boxes, empty rooms and all furniture being disassembled and ready in the garage. They were fully aware of everything that needed to be moved and still failed to uphold their values. Extremely disappointed & would not recommend to anyone.
